text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, after having run through the Twinkle Series
and things had finally calmed down a little...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And here is the pool!
It's so huge, isn't it~!

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume Girls
text_block_list.text: Waah~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser had been recruited
to serve as a guide for the campus open house.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh my.
So many young ladies everywhere.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Fufun! If they join,
Turbo will whip 'em all into shape!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Tannhauser-san,
so you were on the Open Campus executive committee.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Nope! It's not that, the Chairwoman
asked me to do it! *Ahem*.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Directly from Chairwoman Akikawa herself?
Well, that is certainly unusual.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Well, err...

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: "We really look up to Tannhauser-san, and the Chairwoman introduced us so we could meet her in person!"

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
One thing led to another,
and they even ended up showing us around!

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Just like on TV, she's such a kind,
friendly senior... I'm so thrilled!

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
She was so cool at the Arima Kinen,
she's truly our role model!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Fufu, look at that. You really are so well-loved.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"No, no~ Personally, I think you should aim
to be a much more special girl."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"There are plenty of girls at this academy
who sparkle way more brightly, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: They're gonna be so amazed once they enroll!

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: No, it has to be Tannhauser-san!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: I want to be an Umamusume like Tannhauser-san—approachable and full of courage!

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"Even the Chairwoman said that
Matikane Tannhauser is a wonderful Umamusume, right?!"

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume Girls
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"...I see.
Well, that's quite something."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ehehe..., I'm so happy.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are!
Madam Chairwoman~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I've finished guiding them,
so I came to report just in case!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, you have my gratitude!
They were all delighted!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Man, that really gave me a boost of energy too!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...So, um, Chairwoman.
There's actually something I've been wondering about for a while now.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Why do you look after me so much?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Though she had gotten used to it by now... occasionally stopping by to encourage her, telling her, "I have high hopes for you"—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed Chairwoman Akikawa had thought highly
of Matikanetannhauser for quite some time.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I kin~da understood that they liked my ordinariness
and wanted me to give them a little push, but...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mm... Truth be told, I worry that getting
into the details would only put pressure on them!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I held my tongue—
but now that you have grown as much as you have, I shall tell you!
The reason I held such high hopes for you!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Our academy's students are packed with talent!
Its notoriously narrow gate of admission is world-renowned!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: However, there is always a bigger fish!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Behind every glorious victory lies a loser crushed by powerlessness! And because of that—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Countless girls mistakenly believe their own talent is "ordinary"!
In time, it dulls their legs and sometimes even rots their future away!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Nobody is to blame! However,
as Chairwoman, it weighed heavily on my heart nonetheless!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: B-But you! Anyone but you!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Calling herself 'ordinary,' yet never losing her edge.
Even when jostled by geniuses, she simply bounces back with grace!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: "That is precisely why I prayed! That she would become an Umamusume who could lead the countless others who branded themselves as 'ordinary'...!!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: And wonderfully, you made that wish come true!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: At today's open campus, you must have realized it! The presence of the girls chasing after you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh, could it be that's why
you went out of your way to ask me...!?"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mm. That said,
I do not mean to place undue pressure on you!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: I just want you to run your race completely carefree and normal, just like you always have!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Chairwoman...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Haaah~~... Their feelings were much more passionate than I expected, and it took me by surprise.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, yeah. Having people believe in me
really does make me happy."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
The kids who came to the open campus
were all sparkling so brightly, too...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I want to do my best.
Let's give it our all together, okay, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
All right, now that that's settled, time to train!
Speaking of which, I reworked the plan last night!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: How does this plan sound to you!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The notebook she handed me
was, as always, packed densely
with training schedules—
choice_data_list: Aren't you pushing yourself too hard?
Aren't you overdoing it a little?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Huh, not at all!
It's totally normal, really!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: My days with her—unchanged as ever—didn't seem like they would be ending anytime soon.
